order: Original allowed training row order, not a natural temporal stream. Filter reserved workers and original test before reading text or annotations.
feedback: Predict the next unseen training window with both the frozen initial ancestor and the current descendant BEFORE writing that window's training labels to a core input. Then refine the actual previous genome with explicit cumulative replay. No reset from zero between windows.
retention: Reevaluate the initial 2500 taught rows after every update. This is training retention, not independent generalization. Keep all forgetting and errors.
diagnostics: Evaluate the same already-consumed 1504 dev rows after every stage. No policy selection on the results. Compare final whole-training fit separately. The corpus was previously used in other experiments; prequential ordering here is not a fresh independent reserve.
cost: Count the entire lineage: 27526 cumulative training rows times six epochs = 165156 sentence presentations, plus all inference calls. Unknown RSS and energy remain unavailable.
promotion: No production promotion, no M1 certification, no M2. The frozen full M1 completion contract is unchanged. Explicit replay is not proof of autonomous learning without forgetting.
